POSTGRES_USER.description: PostgreSQL initialization user, or the matching connection user for the private database.

POSTGRES_DB.description: Initial PostgreSQL database name, or the matching database selected by the application.

POSTGRES_PASSWORD.description: PostgreSQL password. Generated for the database and referenced by dependent services; keep private.

PGDATA.description: PostgreSQL data directory within the persistent volume. Do not change on an existing database.

PGPORT.description: Pgport for postgres. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection URL assembled from generated credentials and service references. No manual value is needed.

SERVER_PORT.description: Server port for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

SERVER_HOST.description: Server host for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ENVIRONMENT.description: Environment for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DB_HOST.description: Db host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

DB_PORT.description: Db port for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DB_USER.description: Db user for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DB_PASSWORD.description: Db password resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

DB_PREFIX.description: Db prefix for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DB_NAME.description: Db name for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

DB_SSLMODE.description: Db sslmode for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

SECRET_KEY.description: Generated secret key. Keep private and preserve with backups.

ROOT_EMAIL.description: Required operator email. Complete the protected initial setup with this address.

API_ENDPOINT.description: Api endpoint resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

SMTP_BRIDGE_ENABLED.description: Smtp bridge enabled for core. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

NOTIFUSE_LICENSE_KEY.description: Optional paid upstream license; no license is included.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for notifuse. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Owner auth for notifuse. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

OWNER_SCOPE.description: Owner scope for notifuse. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.
